architecture.mechanism: Standardized classification of blade erosion damage based on in-situ conditions
architecture.intervention: Deploy a non-contact optical monitoring system during scheduled service windows to classify leading-edge erosion severity according to the IEA Task 46 taxonomy
architecture.expected_effect: Repairs are targeted only to blades with confirmed critical erosion class, reducing unnecessary repair costs and maintaining energy production efficiency
architecture.falsification_test: Compare historical repair records against the new classification system to verify if repair frequency decreases while energy production losses remain under the 4% threshold
